criteria.blocker: Would require scrolling through all 120+ dispense orders and monitoring network tab — time prohibitive within 45-minute budget. Code inspection confirms getNextPageParam returns null when currentOffset >= lastPage.count, preventing hasNextPage from triggering further fetches.
